items: The compliance team revised the checklist ____ auditors could verify each control more quickly.
'So that' introduces the purpose of revising the checklist.
____ the courier missed the morning pickup, the documents still arrived before the filing deadline.
'Although' introduces a contrast between the missed pickup and the on-time arrival.
The purchasing system sends an alert ____ a supplier changes its bank details.
'If' introduces the condition that triggers an alert.
The downtown branch serves mostly retail customers, ____ the airport branch focuses on corporate travelers.
'Whereas' contrasts the customer focus of the two branches.
Keep the temporary access code active ____ the external consultant finishes the security review.
'Until' marks the endpoint for keeping the temporary access code active.
____ the board approves the capital budget, the facilities team can order the new equipment.
'Once' marks the point after approval when ordering can begin.
The hotel added another shuttle ____ several guests had early-morning flights.
'Because' gives the reason another shuttle was added.
The trainer recorded the demonstration ____ employees in other offices could review it later.
'So that' introduces the purpose of recording the demonstration.
The service agreement will remain in effect ____ the client cancels it in writing.
'Unless' states the exception that would end the agreement.
____ the software is inexpensive to license, it requires extensive staff training.
'While' introduces a contrast between low licensing cost and high training needs.
The accounting manager requested supporting documents ____ several expense claims appeared unusually high.
'Since' gives the reason supporting documents were requested.
Employees may reserve the conference room after hours ____ a security officer is on duty.
'Provided that' states the condition for after-hours room use.
The distribution center will release the shipment ____ the customs documents have been approved.
'After' correctly places shipment release later than document approval.
____ the trial attracts enough participants, the company will expand the program nationwide.
'If' introduces the condition for nationwide expansion.
The restaurant kept the patio closed ____ the rain had stopped by noon.
'Even though' introduces the unexpected contrast between the rain stopping and the patio remaining closed.
The inventory system recalculates stock levels ____ a warehouse records a completed transfer.
'Whenever' means each time a completed transfer is recorded.
The legal team will notify the client ____ the regulator issues its final decision.
'As soon as' marks the earliest point after the decision when notification will occur.
____ the replacement parts arrived on time, the repair could not begin until a specialist was available.
'Although' introduces the contrast between on-time delivery and the delayed repair.
The project manager moved the deadline ____ two contractors requested additional testing time.
'Because' gives the reason the deadline was moved.
The company added captions to every training video ____ employees with hearing impairments could access the material.
'So that' introduces the purpose of adding captions.
The promotional rate applies ____ the customer activates the service before September 15.
'As long as' states the condition for the promotional rate to apply.
____ the older printer is slower, it is cheaper to maintain than the new model.
'While' introduces a contrast between speed and maintenance cost.
The recruiter scheduled a second interview ____ the first panel requested more time with the candidate.
'Because' gives the reason a second interview was scheduled.
The help desk will escalate the ticket ____ the customer reports the same failure again.
'If' introduces the condition that triggers escalation.
The warehouse cannot close for the day ____ every outbound trailer has been logged.
'Until' marks the prerequisite that must be completed before closing.
